bias.en: Bearish · capped at the $1,401 October lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 受制于 $1,401 的 10 月低点

read.en: Sandisk rose 0.9% on Oct 21 to $1,378.22, trading between $1,327.62 and $1,424.48. It is above the falling 5-day ($1,361.8) and rising 200-day ($1,227.4) averages, and below the falling 10-day ($1,437.3), 30-day ($1,615.2) and 100-day ($1,636.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,518.40), and RSI is 37.

The high poked above $1,401 (Oct 13–14 lows) but the close fell back below it, while the low held the $1,325 Jul 17 low for a third session. Resistance is $1,401–1,424, then $1,437 (10-day) and $1,518 (SAR). Support is $1,325, then $1,276 (Oct 15 low) and $1,227 (200-day). A close above $1,424 would target $1,437–1,470; a close below $1,276 would open $1,227.
